tools.name: get_dataset_info
tools.description: Describes the Penguin Statistics drop data: what its numbers mean (times, quantity, drop rate, sanity per item, window), the game servers with their time zones and how fresh the data of each is, the caveats, the license and how to credit it. Call it when unsure how to read or cite the numbers.
